The '''Phateem system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within an unknown sector in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the world of [[Phateem/Legends|Phateem]].
